fetch.rationale: The tool `Fetches a URL` and the schema has `url` / `URL to fetch` with URI format, so it contacts an agent-chosen URL. That makes it a SINK because a request to an attacker-chosen URL/host can carry agent-supplied data, including in the URL. It returns page contents (`optionally extracts its contents as markdown`, `Get the actual HTML content`), so attacker-controlled web content can enter the context, making it UNTRUSTED. The description says `from the internet` and `internet access`, but it does not explicitly restrict schemes/hosts or rule out `localhost`, intranet, or `file://`; under the least-restrictive reading, it may fetch non-public URL contents it can reach, so SECRET is kept and the judgement is undetermined.
